capabilities: Apply a color theme to each vault's window
Choose from preset color themes in settings
Distinguish multiple simultaneously open vault windows
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS snippet manager; it only sets a single window tint per vault from a fixed list of presets.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to visually distinguish multiple open vault windows, so users can lose track of which window belongs to which vault.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the Peacock VS Code extension.

summary: Per-vault window color tool that tints each open vault window with a chosen preset color so multiple vaults are easy to tell apart.
